documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Shaily Engineering Plastics reported its Q1 FY27 financial performance with consolidated revenue increasing 14% year-on-year to INR281 crores and EBITDA growing 18% to INR83 crores. The healthcare segment emerged as the largest business division, driven by pen injector platforms and regulatory approvals for Semaglutide in markets like Canada and Brazil. Meanwhile, the consumer segment experienced softer demand, particularly in home furnishings across Europe and the U.S. Management remains focused on operational execution, ramping up upcoming production capacities, and expanding into new verticals such as consumer electronics and semiconductor trays. guidance.claim: The company aims to go beyond the 36 million pens guidance for the full year.
guidance.quote: Short answer is we should be.

guidance.claim: The company targets to produce around 36 million pens for the current fiscal year.
guidance.quote: I think Amit mentioned 36 million, right, Amit?

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment reflected softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and the United States.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance reflected softer demand in home furnishings across Europe and United States, our largest export markets for the business.

demand_outlook.claim: Consumer revenue declined by 24% largely due to softer demand across Europe and the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: Consumer revenue stood at INR116 crores compared with INR151 crores in Q1 FY26, reflecting a decline of 24%, largely due to softer demand across Europe and U.S.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and USA.
demand_outlook.quote: Weaker Market Demand for Home Furnishings across Europe & USA

demand_outlook.claim: The consumer segment de-grew in Q4 due to weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S.
demand_outlook.quote: The Consumer segment unfortunately de-grew in Q4 '26, primarily reflecting weaker market demand for home furnishings across Europe and the U.S., our 2 largest export markets for this vertical.

capex_expansion.claim: An additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
capex_expansion.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is looking at investing about INR5 crores in the existing facility for semiconductor trays.
capex_expansion.quote: Semiconductor Trays, I think we have mentioned that we are looking at investing about INR5 crores in our existing facility, which would meet initial requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores as an annual affair for financial flexibility.
capex_expansion.quote: Reflecting the confidence in Shaily's next phase of growth and the multiple new opportunities ahead of us, the Board of Directors have approved an enabling resolution to raise up to INR500 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps year-on-year to 29.7%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR83 crores from INR70 crores, reflecting a growth of 18%, while EBITDA margin improved by 120 bps to 29.7%.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin improved to 17.1%, representing an expansion of 40 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin improved to 17.1%, an expansion of 40 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins are expected to return to normalized levels by quarter 3.
margins_costs.quote: We expect that the gross margin would come back to normalized level by quarter 3.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for Q4 FY26 grew 27% year-on-year to INR69 crores.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR69 crores as compared to INR55 crores in Q4 FY '25 a growth of 27% year on year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 stood at 29.3%, reflecting an increase of 420 bps over Q4 FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 29.3%, an increase of 420 bps Q4 FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q4 FY26 was INR40 crores, representing a 40% growth year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: PAT stood at INR40 crores as compared to INR29 crores during Q4 FY '25, a growth of 40% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue for FY26 reached INR991 crores, up 26% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue stood at INR991 crores as compared to INR787 crores during FY '25, a growth of 26% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 29.0%, showing an increase of 630 bps over FY25.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins stood at 29.0%, an increase of 630 bps over FY '25.

margins_costs.claim: ROCE and ROE stood at 35.8% and 26.9% respectively as on March 31, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: Our ROCE and ROE stood at 35.8% and 26.9%, respectively, as on 31st March 2026.

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed pen injector capacity stands at approximately 75 million pens per annum with the upcoming operations.
orders_capacity.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 50.2% during Q1 FY27 compared with 48.7% in Q1 FY26, reflecting a gradual improvement in capacity utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: During the quarter, the company received orders for injector pen supplies following regulatory approvals secured for Semaglutide in Canada and Brazil.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we received orders for injector pen supplies following regulatory approvals secured for the sale of Semaglutide in Canada, Brazil by our pharmaceutical partners.

orders_capacity.claim: The company signed two new platform projects during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: In addition, we have also signed 2 new platform projects, further strengthening our long-term product pipeline.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured a global project from an FMCG customer and won new business in the LED lighting segment.
orders_capacity.quote: In Q1 FY27, we secured a global project from an FMCG customer and also won new business in the LED lighting segment.

orders_capacity.claim: Business confirmations for new projects were received from appliance and automotive customers, alongside onboarding a new customer for 5 consumer electronic components.
orders_capacity.quote: During the quarter, we received business confirmations for new projects from both Appliance as well as Automotive customers. We also onboarded a new customers with orders covering 5 Consumer Electronic components.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates 7 facilities with over 200 molding machines ranging from 35 tons to 1,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: 7 Facilities with over 200 molding machines ranging from 35 tons to 1,000 tons

orders_capacity.claim: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY26 compared to 42.2% in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: Machine utilization improved to 47.6% in FY '26 compared to 42.2% last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Healthcare segment revenue surged 139% to INR393 crores for the full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: For the full year, healthcare revenue surged 139% to INR393 crores, contributing 40% of our consolidated revenue, up from 21% in FY '25.

orders_capacity.claim: Industrial segment revenue for Q4 FY26 grew by 60% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Industrial segment revenue stood at INR22 crores as compared to INR14 crores during Q4 FY '25, a growth of 60%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global operating environment remained challenging due to ongoing uncertainty from the geopolitical situation in West Asia.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global operating environment remained challenging in the quarter with continued uncertainty arising from the geopolitical situation in West Asia and its wider impact on supply chain as well as commodity markets.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues led to volatility in key raw material prices, logistic disruptions, container availability constraints, and elevated freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: This led to volatility in key raw material prices, particularly polymers alongside logistic disruptions, container availability constraints and elevated freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty impacting freight movement, supply chain, and input cost dynamics.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter has witnessed heightened geopolitical uncertainty, particularly due to ongoing tensions across global trade corridors, which impacted freight movement, supply chain and input cost dynamics.

management_commitments.claim: The additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by the end of September.
management_commitments.quote: As committed earlier, our additional 25 million pen capacity is expected to become operational by end of September, taking our total installed pen injector capacity to approximately 75 million pens per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates launching a reusable auto-injector by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: So we're trying to come up with and we're looking at launching by the end of the year, our reusable auto-injector.

management_commitments.claim: The emergency use auto-injector development program will be brought to a closure by the end of '27.
management_commitments.quote: On the emergency use auto-injector, it's a program that we've been working on for roughly 18 months, and we will bring it to a closure by the end of '27.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial supplies for the semiconductor tray client will start in Q4 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Quarter 4 of the current financial year.
